# scell/sdk — PHP SDK for Scell.io
> Version: 2.7.1 | License: MIT | PHP >= 8.2 | Guzzle 7 | PSR HTTP Message 1/2

## v2.7.0 (2026-05-10) — Tenant Signatures URL-nested resource

Release MINOR retro-compatible. Nouvelle ressource `TenantSignatureResource`
qui cible les endpoints URL-nested cote tenant. Auth backend : middleware
`tenant.key` (header `X-API-Key sk_live_*` / `sk_test_*`), SANS contrainte
`company_id` — un master tenant peut lister toutes ses signatures (parent +
tous sub-tenants) sans devoir creer une cle API attachee a une company.

### Endpoints couverts

| Endpoint | Methode SDK |
|----------|-------------|
| `GET /api/v1/tenant/signatures` | `signatures()->list($filters)` |
| `GET /api/v1/tenant/signatures/{id}` | `signatures()->get($id)` |
| `GET /api/v1/tenant/sub-tenants/{subTenantId}/signatures` | `signatures()->listForSubTenant($subTenantId, $filters)` |
| `GET /api/v1/tenant/sub-tenants/{subTenantId}/signatures/{id}` | `signatures()->getForSubTenant($subTenantId, $id)` |

Les operations write (create, remind, cancel, download, audit-trail)
restent sur `/v1/signatures` via `SignatureResource` (inchange).

### Surfaces clients

```php
use Scell\Sdk\ScellTenantClient;
use Scell\Sdk\ScellApiClient;
use Scell\Sdk\Enums\SignatureStatus;

// Option A : client tenant dedie
$tenant = ScellTenantClient::create('tk_live_xxx');
$sigs = $tenant->signatures()->list([
    'status'      => SignatureStatus::Completed,
    'environment' => 'production',
    'per_page'    => 50,
]);

// Option B : client API server-side (sk_*)
$api = ScellApiClient::withApiKey('sk_live_xxx');
$sigs = $api->tenantSignatures()->list(['status' => 'pending']);

// Limiter a un sub-tenant precis (anti-IDOR cote middleware)
$subSigs = $tenant->signatures()->listForSubTenant('sub-tenant-uuid', [
    'status' => 'pending',
]);

// Detail
$signature = $tenant->signatures()->get('signature-uuid');
$sigSub = $tenant->signatures()->getForSubTenant('sub-tenant-uuid', 'signature-uuid');
```

### Filtres `signatures()->list()` / `listForSubTenant()`

| Filtre        | Type                       | Effet |
|---------------|----------------------------|-------|
| `status`      | `SignatureStatus` / string | `pending` \| `completed` \| `refused` \| `expired` |
| `environment` | string                     | `sandbox` \| `production` |
| `per_page`    | int                        | 1 a 100 (defaut backend = 25) |
| `page`        | int                        | Numero de page Laravel (1-indexe) |

Pagination : `data: Signature[]`, `meta: { current_page, per_page, total, last_page }`.

### Pourquoi cette ressource

Avant la v2.7.0, `SignatureResource::list()` et `::get()` (sous `/v1/signatures`)
exigeaient une cle API attachee a une `company_id`. Les master tenants sans
`company_id` (ou souhaitant un acces cross-company) recevaient
`403 COMPANY_REQUIRED`. Le nouveau pattern URL-nested suit la convention
deja en place pour `/v1/tenant/invoices` et `/v1/tenant/credit-notes`.

## v2.6.0 (2026-05-10) — Signatures list/get exposed to SDKs (tenant scope)

Release MINOR retro-compatible. `GET /api/v1/signatures` et `GET
/api/v1/signatures/{id}` sont desormais consommables par les SDKs avec
auth `sk_live_*` / `sk_test_*` (avant : Sanctum SPA only). Le scope
backend est passe de `user_id` a `tenant_id` (via `company.tenant_id`).

### Filtres `signatures()->list()`

| Filtre          | Type                                | Effet |
|-----------------|-------------------------------------|-------|
| `status`        | `SignatureStatus` / string          | Statut courant (`pending`, `completed`, ...) |
| `environment`   | `'production'` / `'sandbox'`        | Source de l'enregistrement |
| `company_id`    | UUID                                | Limite a une Company precise |
| `sub_tenant_id` | UUID                                | Limite a un sub-tenant (anti-IDOR, 403 si != tenant courant) |
| `per_page`      | int (max 100)                       | Pagination |
| `page`          | int                                 | Page courante |

```php
use Scell\Sdk\ScellApiClient;
use Scell\Sdk\Enums\SignatureStatus;

$api = new ScellApiClient('sk_live_xxx');

// Toutes les signatures pending du tenant + ses sub-tenants
$signatures = $api->signatures()->list([
    'status' => SignatureStatus::Pending,
    'per_page' => 50,
]);

// Limite a un sub-tenant precis (verification anti-IDOR cote backend)
$subOnly = $api->signatures()->list([
    'sub_tenant_id' => '019d5ea8-...',
]);

// Get unitaire (meme scope tenant_id)
$one = $api->signatures()->get('sig_xxx');
```

### Bug backend fixe (release SDK declenchee par)

`GET /api/v1/signatures` retournait 500 sous auth `api.key` (sk_*) car
`$request->user()->id` n'etait pas resolu (user resolver non pose pour
cette auth). Fix cote backend ; aucune modif cote SDK requise pour
beneficier du fix, mais la doc / les tests / la version sont alignes.

## v2.4.0 (2026-05-10) — Fix CompanyData / SireneLookupResult parsing

Release patch critique. Le DTO `CompanyData` lisait l'adresse en shape
nested (`data.address.line1`) alors que l'API renvoie tout a plat
(`data.address_line1`). Resultat : tous les champs adresse arrivaient
en chaine vide. Ce bug existait depuis v2.0.0 et rendait inutilisable
le pre-fill du formulaire d'onboarding cote partenaire widget.

### Fix DTO `CompanyData`

```php
// Shape JSON reelle de l'API (capture prod RL CONSEIL 2026-05-10)
[
    'name' => 'RL CONSEIL',
    'legal_name' => 'RL CONSEIL',           // <- nouveau
    'siret' => '10178342100015',
    'siren' => '101783421',
    'vat_number' => 'FR95101783421',
    'legal_form' => '5710',
    'naf_code' => '62.02A',
    'address_line1' => '200 RUE DE LA CROIX NIVERT', // <- a plat (etait nested)
    'address_line2' => null,
    'postal_code' => '75015',
    'city' => 'PARIS',
    'country' => 'FR',
    'is_active' => true,
    'creation_date' => '2026-01-19',        // <- renomme depuis created_at
    'employee_range' => 'NN',               // <- nouveau
]
```

### Fix DTO `SireneLookupResult` — 3 cas discrimines

```php
$result = $public->onboarding()->lookupSirene('10178342100015');

// Cas 1 : success
if ($result->sireneLookupSucceeded && $result->data !== null) {
    echo $result->data->name;            // 'RL CONSEIL'
    echo $result->data->addressLine1;    // '200 RUE DE LA CROIX NIVERT'
    echo $result->data->city;            // 'PARIS'
}

// Cas 2 : manual_entry fallback (Etalab + INSEE down)
if ($result->manualEntryRequired) {
    // $result->code === 'SIRENE_MANUAL_ENTRY_REQUIRED'
    // $result->data === null
    // afficher le formulaire en saisie manuelle
}

// Cas 3 : SIRET introuvable (404)
if ($result->code === 'SIRENE_NOT_FOUND') {
    // afficher "SIRET inconnu"
}
```

### Migration depuis v2.3.0

Aucun breaking sur la signature publique du DTO — les noms des proprietes
(`addressLine1`, `postalCode`, `city`...) sont inchanges. Le bug etait
purement dans `fromArray()`. **Si vous lisiez `$company->addressLine1`
avant et qu'il etait vide → la mise a jour suffit pour qu'il soit peuple
correctement.**

Nouveau champs accessibles :
- `$company->legalName` (raison sociale)
- `$company->creationDate` (date d'immatriculation)
- `$company->employeeRange`
- `$result->manualEntryRequired` (bool)
- `$result->code` (?string)

`$company->createdAt` (v2.3.0 et anterieures) reste lu depuis l'API si
present (fallback) mais l'expose en tant que `$company->creationDate`.

---

## v2.3.0 (2026-05-10) — Publishable Key auth (`X-Publishable-Key`)

Release mineure additive. Comble un gap critique : les endpoints widget
public (`/widget/onboarding/sirene/lookup`, `/widget/onboarding/sub-tenant`)
exigent le header `X-Publishable-Key`. Avant v2.3.0, le SDK n'exposait
aucune methode pour ce header — `ScellApiClient::withApiKey('pk_live_...')`
envoyait incorrectement `X-API-Key: pk_live_*` (rejete cote serveur).

> Pas d'entree `version` dans `composer.json`. Composer lit la version
> depuis le tag Git `v2.3.0`.

### Nouvelle classe `ScellPublicClient`

Mirror du `ScellPublicClient` du SDK JS (`@scell/sdk`). Recommande pour les
contextes widget public (browser-safe, cle pk_*).

```php
use Scell\Sdk\ScellPublicClient;

$public = new ScellPublicClient('pk_live_...');

// Sirene lookup
$lookup = $public->onboarding()->lookupSirene('12345678901234');
if ($lookup->data !== null) {
    echo $lookup->data->name;
}

// SubTenant creation depuis le widget
$result = $public->onboarding()->createSubTenant([
    'company'  => $lookup->data,
    'identity' => [
        'first_name' => 'Marie',
        'last_name'  => 'Dupont',
        'email'      => 'marie@acme.fr',
    ],
    'locale'   => 'fr',
]);
// $result->subTenant : SubTenant
// $result->resumeUrl : ?string (signed URL 7 jours)
```

### Alternative : `ScellApiClient::withPublishableKey()`

Pratique si vous voulez UN seul client en partageant la config :

```php
use Scell\Sdk\ScellApiClient;

$public = ScellApiClient::withPublishableKey('pk_live_...');
$lookup = $public->onboarding()->lookupSirene('12345678901234');
```

### Nouveau header HTTP

| Methode SDK                                  | Header HTTP             | Cle              |
|----------------------------------------------|-------------------------|------------------|
| `HttpClient::withBearerToken($token)`        | `Authorization: Bearer` | JWT (dashboard)  |
| `HttpClient::withApiKey($sk)`                | `X-API-Key`             | `sk_live_*`      |
| `HttpClient::withTenantKey($tk)`             | `X-Tenant-Key`          | `tk_*` (legacy)  |
| **`HttpClient::withPublishableKey($pk)`** ⭐ | **`X-Publishable-Key`** | **`pk_live_*`**  |

### Migration depuis v2.2.0

Aucun breaking change. Si vous utilisiez deja le hack
`ScellApiClient::withApiKey('pk_live_...')` (qui ne fonctionnait pas),
remplacer par :

```php
// AVANT (cassait sur les endpoints widget — 401)
$client = ScellApiClient::withApiKey('pk_live_xxx');

// APRES (fonctionne)
$client = ScellApiClient::withPublishableKey('pk_live_xxx');
// ou
$client = new ScellPublicClient('pk_live_xxx');
```

### Bonus : drift `SDK_VERSION` corrige

La constante `HttpClient::SDK_VERSION` etait restee a `'1.12.0'` malgre
les releases successives. Elle reflete maintenant `'2.3.0'`. Cette
constante est utilisee dans le header `User-Agent` envoye par chaque requete.

---

## v2.2.0 (2026-05-10) — Billing Invoice Pay (Stripe)

Release mineure additive. Ajoute le paiement Stripe des factures plateforme.

> Pas d'entree `version` dans `composer.json`. Composer lit la version
> depuis le tag Git `v2.2.0`.

### Nouvelle methode `BillingResource::payInvoice()`

```php
use Scell\Sdk\ScellApiClient;
use Scell\Sdk\DTOs\PaymentIntent;

$api = ScellApiClient::withApiKey('sk_live_xxx');

/** @var PaymentIntent $pi */
$pi = $api->billing()->payInvoice('billing-invoice-uuid');

// Passer le client_secret a Stripe.js cote client
echo $pi->clientSecret;       // cs_live_...
echo $pi->paymentIntentId;    // pi_...
echo $pi->amount;             // 4900 (centimes)
echo $pi->currency;           // "eur"
echo $pi->status;             // "requires_payment_method"
```

**Erreurs** : `ScellException` 404 (facture autre tenant) · 422 (statut non payable : draft, paid, cancelled).

---

## v2.1.0 (2026-05-08) — Tenant Invoice Download

Release mineure additive. Comble une lacune : les API keys tenant
(`sk_live_*` / `sk_test_*`) ne pouvaient pas telecharger le Factur-X /
UBL / CII des factures creees via `tenantInvoices()->create(...)` ou
`tenantInvoices()->createForSubTenant(...)`.

> Pas d'entree `version` dans `composer.json`. Composer lit la version
> depuis le tag Git `v2.1.0`.

### Nouvelles methodes sur `TenantInvoiceResource`

```php
use Scell\Sdk\ScellClient;

$client = new ScellClient(apiKey: 'sk_live_xxx');

// Telecharger une facture tenant directe (Factur-X PDF/A-3 par defaut)
$pdf = $client->tenantInvoices()->download('019d-uuid');
file_put_contents('invoice.pdf', $pdf);

// XML pur (UBL ou CII selon output_format de la facture)
$xml = $client->tenantInvoices()->download('019d-uuid', 'xml');

// Scope sub-tenant (404 si la facture appartient a un autre sub-tenant)
$pdf = $client->tenantInvoices()->downloadForSubTenant(
    'sub-tenant-uuid',
    'invoice-uuid',
);

// Formats: 'facturx' (default) | 'pdf' (alias) | 'xml'
```

Les deux methodes renvoient une `string` (contenu binaire brut). Pas de
presigned URL — le download est synchrone via le backend Scell.

### Endpoints backend

- `GET /api/v1/tenant/invoices/{invoiceId}/download[?format=facturx|pdf|xml]`
- `GET /api/v1/tenant/sub-tenants/{subTenantId}/invoices/{invoiceId}/download[?format=]`

Auth: `X-API-Key: sk_*` (server-side uniquement, jamais publishable key).

---

## v2.0.0 (2026-05-08) — Breaking Changes

Major release. Aligne le SDK PHP sur Scell.io API v2 (onboarding pilote
par SuperPDP). Backend requis : Scell.io API v2.0+.

> Pas d'entree `version` dans `composer.json`. Composer lit la version
> depuis le tag Git `v2.0.0`.

### What changed

- `SubTenant` n'expose plus `kycStatus` / `kycVerifiedAt` / `kycDelegated`.
- Nouveau champ obligatoire `OnboardingStatus $onboardingStatus` (BackedEnum, 6 valeurs).
- Nouveaux champs SubTenant : `superpdpCompanyVerificationStatus`,
  `superpdpUserIdentityVerificationStatus`, `lastPolledAt`,
  `resumeUrl`, `contactFirstName`, `contactLastName`.
- 5 nouveaux endpoints (lookup Sirene, creation widget, statut SuperPDP, refresh, resume URL).

### Migration: `kycStatus` → `onboardingStatus`

| Legacy `kycStatus`  | Nouveau `OnboardingStatus`                                                                          |
|---------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `'pending'`         | `PendingSuperPDP`, `SuperPDPRedirected`, `SuperPDPAuthorized`, `SuperPDPPendingReview`              |
| `'verified'`        | `Active`                                                                                            |
| `'rejected'`        | `SuperPDPFailed`                                                                                    |

```php
// AVANT (v1.x)
if ($subTenant->kycStatus === 'verified') { /* ... */ }

// APRES (v2.0)
use Scell\Sdk\Enums\OnboardingStatus;
if ($subTenant->onboardingStatus === OnboardingStatus::Active) { /* ... */ }
// ou
if ($subTenant->isOnboarded()) { /* ... */ }
```

## Onboarding v2 — Widget endpoints (publishable-key)

> Depuis v2.3.0 : utiliser `ScellPublicClient` ou
> `ScellApiClient::withPublishableKey('pk_live_...')`. Les anciennes versions
> cassaient car `withApiKey('pk_live_...')` envoyait le mauvais header
> (`X-API-Key` au lieu de `X-Publishable-Key`).

```php
use Scell\Sdk\ScellPublicClient;
use Scell\Sdk\DTOs\CompanyData;

$publicClient = new ScellPublicClient('pk_live_...');

// 1. Sirene lookup
$lookup = $publicClient->onboarding()->lookupSirene('12345678901234');
// $lookup->data : ?CompanyData
// $lookup->sireneLookupSucceeded : bool

// 2. Create sub-tenant from widget data
$result = $publicClient->onboarding()->createSubTenant([
    'external_id' => 'crm-42',
    'company' => $lookup->data,
    'identity' => [
        'first_name' => 'Marie',
        'last_name' => 'Dupont',
        'email' => 'marie@acme.fr',
    ],
    'locale' => 'fr',
]);
// $result->subTenant : SubTenant
// $result->recommendedAction : ?RecommendedAction
// $result->resumeUrl : ?string  (signed URL valid 7 days)
```

## SubTenants SuperPDP status v2 — Bearer auth

```php
use Scell\Sdk\Exceptions\RateLimitException;

// Cached status + i18n recommended action
$summary = $api->subTenants()->getSuperPDPStatus($subTenantId);
// $summary->subTenant : SubTenant
// $summary->recommendedAction : ?RecommendedAction
echo $summary->recommendedAction?->title('fr');

// Force fresh poll (rate-limited 1/min/sub-tenant)
try {
    $fresh = $api->subTenants()->refreshSuperPDPStatus($subTenantId);
} catch (RateLimitException $e) {
    // backoff or fall back to getSuperPDPStatus()
}

// Regenerate signed resume URL (valid 7 days)
$resume = $api->subTenants()->getResumeUrl($subTenantId);
// $resume->resumeUrl : string
// $resume->expiresAt : DateTimeImmutable
```

## RecommendedAction (i18n FR/EN)

```php
final readonly class RecommendedAction {
    public string $code;
    public string $severity;       // 'info' | 'warning' | 'critical' | 'success'
    public string $titleFr; public string $titleEn;
    public string $messageFr; public string $messageEn;
    public string $ctaLabelFr; public string $ctaLabelEn;
    public ?string $ctaUrl;
    public bool $dismissible;
    public function title(string $locale = 'fr'): string;
    public function message(string $locale = 'fr'): string;
    public function ctaLabel(string $locale = 'fr'): string;
}
```

---


## Overview

Scell.io is a B2B micro-SaaS platform providing:
- Electronic invoicing compliant with French and EU standards (Factur-X PDF/A-3, UBL 2.1, UN/CEFACT CII)
- Simple electronic signatures (eIDAS EU-SES) with OTP authentication (email/SMS)
- ISCA fiscal compliance (immutable ledger, SHA-256 hash chain, daily closings, FEC export)
- Multi-tenant architecture for partner integrations (sub-tenants, direct invoices, incoming invoices)
- Partner onboarding via SuperPDP OAuth2 Authorization Code flow

## Installation

```bash
composer require scell/sdk
```

Requirements: PHP 8.2+, guzzlehttp/guzzle ^7.0

## B2C Support — Particulier (Private Individual Buyer)

Since v1.13.0, Scell.io supports B2C invoices and credit notes where the
buyer is a private individual (no SIRET / SIREN / VAT / legal_id).

### When to use B2C

| Buyer | Mode | `buyer_is_individual` |
|-------|------|----------------------|
| French company (FR) | B2B | `false` (default) |
| EU company (BE, DE, IT...) | B2B | `false` |
| Non-EU company (US, CN...) | B2B | `false` |
| Private individual (FR, EU, world) | **B2C** | `true` |

### Effects when `buyer_is_individual = true`

- **Validation server-side** : `buyer_siret`, `buyer_siren`, `buyer_vat_number`,
  `buyer_legal_id` are NOT required, even for `buyer_country = 'FR'`.
- **Factur-X / UBL / CII generation** : balises `BT-46` (BuyerLegalOrganisation),
  `BT-47` (BuyerTaxIdentifier scheme=FC), `BT-48` (BuyerVATIdentifier scheme=VA)
  are OMITTED for the buyer party. Only `BT-44` (Name) and `BG-8` (Address) are
  included. This is conformant with EN16931 BR-CO-26.
- **Payment terms** : the legally-required B2B mentions from French Code de
  commerce article L441-10 (late payment penalties = 3x legal interest rate +
  fixed recovery indemnity of 40 EUR) are automatically removed.
- **Credit notes** : credit notes inherit `buyer_is_individual` from their
  source invoice. ISCA fiscal compliance is preserved.

### How to use

**Builder (recommended)** :
```php
$invoice = $client->invoices()->builder()
    ->outgoing()->facturX()
    ->issueDate('2026-05-03')
    ->seller('12345678901234', 'My Co SAS', $sellerAddress)
    ->buyerIndividual('Marie Dupont', $buyerAddress)  // <-- B2C
    ->addLine('Coaching', 1.0, 150.00, 20.0)
    ->create();
```

**Raw array** :
```php
$invoice = $client->invoices()->create([
    // ...
    'buyer_name'           => 'Marie Dupont',
    'buyer_address'        => [...],
    'buyer_country'        => 'FR',
    'buyer_is_individual'  => true,   // <-- B2C
    // No buyer_siret / buyer_vat_number / buyer_legal_id needed
]);
```

**Tenant Direct API** :
```php
$invoice = $client->tenantDirectInvoices()->create([
    'company_id' => $companyId,
    'buyer' => [
        'company_name'  => 'Marie Dupont',  // full name for individuals
        'address'       => [...],
        'email'         => 'marie@example.com',
        'is_individual' => true,             // <-- B2C
    ],
    'lines' => [...],
]);
```

### Inspect B2C status on existing invoice

```php
$invoice = $client->invoices()->get($id);

if ($invoice->isB2c()) {
    echo "Particulier";
} else {
    echo "Entreprise " . $invoice->buyerSiret;
}
```

### Migrating existing B2B code

No breaking change. All existing calls keep working — `buyer_is_individual`
defaults to `false`. To opt-in:

1. Replace `->buyer($siret, $name, $addr)` with
   `->buyerIndividual($name, $addr)` for individual buyers, OR
2. Add `->asB2c()` to an existing builder, OR
3. Pass `'buyer_is_individual' => true` in raw array calls.

## Invoice Templates — Personnalisation factures / avoirs (since v1.14.0)

Personnalisation visuelle (logo, couleurs, mentions) avec resolution cascade.

### Cascade de resolution (cote serveur)

1. `invoice.invoice_template_id` explicit (passe au create)
2. Default sub_tenant template (scope=sub_tenant, is_default=true)
3. Default tenant template (scope=tenant, is_default=true)
   - Si invoice cote sub_tenant : doit avoir `is_available_to_subtenants=true`
4. Default system template (scope=system, is_default=true)

### CRUD via `$client->invoiceTemplates()`

```php
// Lister
$page = $client->invoiceTemplates()->list(['scope' => 'tenant', 'per_page' => 25]);

// Recuperer
$tpl = $client->invoiceTemplates()->get('uuid');

// Creer
$tpl = $client->invoiceTemplates()->create([
    'scope' => 'tenant',
    'name' => 'Brand Q4 2026',
    'logo_url' => 'https://cdn.client.com/logo.svg',
    'primary_color' => '#0F172A',
    'accent_color' => '#F472B6',
    'custom_mentions' => 'TVA non applicable, art. 293 B du CGI',
    'is_default' => true,
    'is_available_to_subtenants' => true,
]);

// Modifier
$tpl = $client->invoiceTemplates()->update($tpl->id, ['name' => 'Renamed']);

// Marquer comme default
$tpl = $client->invoiceTemplates()->markDefault($tpl->id);

// Supprimer (soft delete)
$client->invoiceTemplates()->delete($tpl->id);
```

### Utiliser un template lors de la creation

```php
$invoice = $client->invoices()->builder()
    ->outgoing()->facturX()
    ->seller(...)
    ->buyer(...)
    ->addLine(...)
    ->create([
        'invoice_template_id' => $tpl->id, // override explicit
    ]);
```

### Champs

| Champ | Type | Note |
|-------|------|------|
| `scope` | `system` \| `tenant` \| `sub_tenant` | system reserve Scell |
| `tenant_id` | UUID | requis si scope=tenant ou sub_tenant |
| `sub_tenant_id` | UUID | requis si scope=sub_tenant |
| `name` | string | max 255 |
| `is_default` | bool | un seul default par owner |
| `is_available_to_subtenants` | bool | scope=tenant only ; partage avec sub-tenants |
| `logo_url` | URL | max 2048 chars |
| `logo_position` | `top-left` \| `top-center` \| `top-right` | defaut top-left |
| `primary_color`, `accent_color`, `text_color`, `background_color` | hex `#RRGGBB` | optionnel |
| `header_text`, `footer_text` | text | max 500 chars chacun |
| `custom_mentions` | text | max 2000 chars — injecte dans Factur-X payment terms |
| `advanced_options` | array | future-proofing (font, watermark, layout) |

### Scope owner — qui peut quoi

| Action | system | tenant own | sub_tenant own | tenant available_to | other |
|--------|--------|------------|----------------|---------------------|-------|
| view | OUI | OUI | OUI | OUI (read-only) | NON |
| create | NON | OUI | OUI | — | NON |
| update | NON | OUI | OUI | NON | NON |
| delete | NON | OUI | OUI | NON | NON |
| markDefault | NON | OUI | OUI | NON | NON |

---

## Daily Closure — Cloture quotidienne automatique

Chaque jour a 00:05 UTC, un job cron execute `php artisan fiscal:daily-closing`
qui :
1. Cree une `FiscalClosing` pour chaque tenant actif (meme sans activite).
2. Genere le hash de cloture (chaine ISCA).
3. Genere le CSV au format de marche (colonnes : `increment_id, type, saving_date, document_date, total_excl_tax` + ligne Total).
4. Stocke le CSV sur S3.
5. Envoie un email a `tenant.email` avec le recap chiffre + signed URL telecharger CSV (valable 5 jours).

### Format email (corps Markdown)

```
- Type de cloture : Journaliere
- Du : {start} UTC
- Au : {end} UTC
- Nombre de documents : {count}
- Total hors taxe : {total_ht} {currency}
- Montant des taxes : {total_tax} {currency}
- Empreinte du block : {closing_hash}
- Empreinte du fichier : {csv_hash}

[Telecharger votre cloture au format CSV]
```

### Recuperer une cloture par API

```php
// Liste
$closings = $client->fiscal()->closings(['from' => '2026-05-01', 'to' => '2026-05-03']);

// Detail (avec metadata.csv_path)
$closing = $client->fiscal()->getClosing($id);
```

Le CSV est telechargeable via signed URL (route Laravel `signed`) — voir l'email recu.

---

## Authentication Modes

Three client classes, each for a different authentication context:

| Class | Header | Key format | Use case |
|-------|--------|------------|----------|
| `ScellClient` | `Authorization: Bearer <token>` | User session token | Dashboard / user-authenticated context |
| `ScellApiClient` | `X-API-Key: <key>` | `tk_live_*` or `tk_test_*` | Server-to-server integrations |
| `ScellTenantClient` | `X-Tenant-Key: <key>` | `tk_live_*` or `tk_test_*` | Multi-tenant partner integrations |

**Important:** Sandbox routing is server-side by key prefix (`tk_test_*` vs `tk_live_*`). Both environments use the same URL: `https://api.scell.io/api/v1`. There is no separate sandbox subdomain.

---

## ScellClient — Bearer Token Authentication

```php
use Scell\Sdk\ScellClient;

// Production
$client = new ScellClient(bearerToken: 'eyJ...');

// With custom config
use Scell\Sdk\Config;
$config = Config::fromArray([
    'timeout' => 60,
    'retry_attempts' => 5,
]);
$client = new ScellClient(bearerToken: 'eyJ...', config: $config);
```

### ScellClient Accessors

```php
$client->invoices()       // InvoiceResource
$client->signatures()     // SignatureResource
$client->companies()      // CompanyResource
$client->balance()        // BalanceResource
$client->webhooks()       // WebhookResource
$client->creditNotes()    // CreditNoteResource
$client->apiKeys()        // ApiKeyResource
```

---

## ScellApiClient — API Key Authentication

```php
use Scell\Sdk\ScellApiClient;

// Production
$api = ScellApiClient::withApiKey('tk_live_abc123...');

// Sandbox (same URL, routing by key prefix)
$api = ScellApiClient::sandbox('tk_test_abc123...');

// Local development
$api = ScellApiClient::local('tk_test_abc123...', 'http://localhost:8000/api/v1');
```

### ScellApiClient Accessors

All `ScellClient` accessors plus:

```php
$api->invoices()          // InvoiceResource
$api->signatures()        // SignatureResource
$api->companies()         // CompanyResource
$api->balance()           // BalanceResource
$api->webhooks()          // WebhookResource
$api->creditNotes()       // CreditNoteResource
$api->apiKeys()           // ApiKeyResource
$api->subTenants()        // SubTenantResource
$api->fiscal()            // FiscalResource
$api->stats()             // StatsResource
$api->billing()           // BillingResource
$api->tenantInvoices()    // TenantInvoiceResource
$api->directInvoices()    // TenantDirectInvoiceResource
$api->incomingInvoices()  // TenantIncomingInvoiceResource
$api->onboarding()        // OnboardingResource
```

## Config

```php
use Scell\Sdk\Config;

// Default (production)
$config = new Config();

// Sandbox
$config = Config::sandbox();

// Local dev
$config = Config::local('http://localhost:8000/api/v1');

// Custom
$config = Config::fromArray([
    'base_url'        => 'https://api.scell.io/api/v1',
    'timeout'         => 60,
    'connect_timeout' => 15,
    'retry_attempts'  => 5,
    'retry_delay'     => 200,
    'verify_ssl'      => true,
]);
```

Config properties (all public readonly):
- `baseUrl: string` — Default: `https://api.scell.io/api/v1`
- `timeout: int` — Default: 30
- `connectTimeout: int` — Default: 10
- `retryAttempts: int` — Default: 3
- `retryDelay: int` — Default: 100 (ms, exponential backoff)
- `verifySsl: bool` — Default: true

Both `DEFAULT_BASE_URL` and `SANDBOX_BASE_URL` constants equal `https://api.scell.io/api/v1`.

---

## InvoiceResource

Accessed via `$client->invoices()`, `$api->invoices()`, etc.

### list()

```php
use Scell\Sdk\Enums\Direction;
use Scell\Sdk\Enums\InvoiceStatus;

$result = $client->invoices()->list([
    'direction'   => Direction::Outgoing,   // or 'outgoing'
    'status'      => InvoiceStatus::Draft,  // or 'draft'
    'environment' => 'production',
    'company_id'  => 'uuid-here',
    'from'        => new DateTime('2026-01-01'), // or '2026-01-01'
    'to'          => new DateTime('2026-12-31'),
    'per_page'    => 50,
    'page'        => 1,
]);
// Returns PaginatedResult<Invoice>
foreach ($result->data as $invoice) { /* Invoice */ }
echo $result->total;
echo $result->perPage;
echo $result->currentPage;
$result->hasNextPage();
$result->hasPreviousPage();
```

### get()

```php
$invoice = $client->invoices()->get('uuid-of-invoice');
// Returns Invoice DTO
```

### create() — Raw array

```php
use Scell\Sdk\Enums\Direction;
use Scell\Sdk\Enums\OutputFormat;
use Scell\Sdk\DTOs\Address;
use Scell\Sdk\DTOs\InvoiceLine;

$invoice = $client->invoices()->create([
    'direction'       => Direction::Outgoing,     // 'outgoing' or Direction enum
    'output_format'   => OutputFormat::FacturX,   // 'facturx', 'ubl', 'cii'
    'issue_date'      => '2026-01-26',            // or DateTimeInterface
    'due_date'        => '2026-02-26',            // optional
    'currency'        => 'EUR',                   // optional, default EUR
    'total_ht'        => 100.00,
    'total_tax'       => 20.00,
    'total_ttc'       => 120.00,
    'seller_siret'    => '12345678901234',
    'seller_name'     => 'Ma Societe SAS',
    'seller_address'  => [
        'street'      => '1 rue de la Paix',
        'city'        => 'Paris',
        'postal_code' => '75001',
        'country'     => 'FR',
    ],
    'buyer_siret'     => '98765432109876',
    'buyer_name'      => 'Client SA',
    'buyer_address'   => new Address(
        street:     '10 avenue de la Gare',
        city:       'Lyon',
        postalCode: '69001',
        country:    'FR',
    ),
    'lines' => [
        InvoiceLine::create('Consulting', 2.0, 500.00, 20.0),
        [
            'description' => 'Formation',
            'quantity'    => 1.0,
            'unit_price'  => 1500.00,
            'tax_rate'    => 20.0,
            'total_ht'    => 1500.00,
            'total_tax'   => 300.00,
            'total_ttc'   => 1800.00,
        ],
    ],
    'external_id'      => 'MY-REF-001',           // optional
    'archive_enabled'  => true,                    // optional
]);
// Returns Invoice DTO
// invoice_number is server-generated (DRAFT-XXXXX at creation, fiscal number at submit)
```

### create() — Fluent builder

```php
use Scell\Sdk\DTOs\Address;

$invoice = $client->invoices()->builder()
    ->outgoing()
    ->facturX()
    ->externalId('MY-REF-001')
    ->issueDate('2026-01-26')
    ->dueDate('2026-02-26')
    ->currency('EUR')
    ->seller(
        siret:   '12345678901234',
        name:    'Ma Societe SAS',
        address: new Address('1 rue de la Paix', 'Paris', '75001', 'FR')
    )
    ->buyer(
        siret:   '98765432109876',
        name:    'Client SA',
        address: new Address('10 av. de la Gare', 'Lyon', '69001', 'FR')
    )
    ->addLine('Consulting',  2.0,    500.00, 20.0)
    ->addLine('Formation',   1.0,   1500.00, 20.0)
    ->archiveEnabled()
    ->create(); // auto-calculates totals
```

### builder() — InvoiceBuilder methods

```php
$builder = $client->invoices()->builder();

// Direction
$builder->direction(Direction::Outgoing)
$builder->outgoing()    // shortcut
$builder->incoming()    // shortcut

// Format
$builder->format(OutputFormat::FacturX)
$builder->facturX()     // shortcut
$builder->ubl()         // shortcut
$builder->cii()         // shortcut

// Dates
$builder->issueDate(DateTimeInterface|string $date)
$builder->dueDate(DateTimeInterface|string $date)

// Metadata
$builder->externalId(string $id)
$builder->currency(string $currency)  // 'EUR', 'USD', etc.
$builder->archiveEnabled(bool $enabled = true)

// Parties
$builder->seller(string $siret, string $name, Address|array $address)
$builder->buyer(?string $siret, string $name, Address|array $address)
                              // siret is optional since v1.13.0 (B2C)

// B2C helpers (v1.13.0+)
$builder->buyerIndividual(string $name, Address|array $address)
                              // sets buyer_is_individual=true automatically
$builder->asB2c(bool $value = true)
                              // explicit flag toggle on existing builder

// Lines
$builder->addLine(string $description, float $quantity, float $unitPrice, float $taxRate)
$builder->addLineDto(InvoiceLine $line)

// Create (auto-calculates totals)
$builder->create(): Invoice

// @deprecated since v1.9.0 — no-op, kept for backward compat
$builder->invoiceNumber(string $number)
```

### B2C example — buyer is a private individual

```php
use Scell\Sdk\DTOs\Address;

$invoice = $client->invoices()->builder()
    ->outgoing()
    ->facturX()
    ->externalId('COACH-2026-001')
    ->issueDate('2026-05-03')
    ->seller(
        siret:   '12345678901234',
        name:    'Coach Pro SAS',
        address: new Address('1 rue de la Paix', 'Paris', '75001', 'FR')
    )
    // No SIRET on the buyer — particulier
    ->buyerIndividual(
        name:    'Marie Dupont',
        address: new Address('12 rue de Rivoli', 'Paris', '75001', 'FR')
    )
    ->addLine('Coaching individuel', 1.0, 150.00, 20.0)
    ->create();

assert($invoice->isB2c() === true);
// Generated Factur-X:
//   - BG-7 BuyerParty has only Name + Address
//   - BT-46 (BuyerLegalOrganisation) — OMITTED (BR-CO-26)
//   - BT-47 (BuyerTaxIdentifier)     — OMITTED
//   - BT-48 (BuyerVATIdentifier)     — OMITTED
// Payment terms : no L441-10 mentions (penalites, indemnite forfaitaire)
```

### incoming()

```php
$result = $client->invoices()->incoming([
    'status'   => 'received',
    'from'     => '2026-01-01',
    'to'       => '2026-12-31',
    'per_page' => 25,
    'page'     => 1,
]);
// Returns PaginatedResult<Invoice>
```

### accept()

```php
$invoice = $client->invoices()->accept('invoice-uuid', [
    'comment'  => 'Facture conforme',  // optional
    'metadata' => ['po_number' => 'PO-001'],  // optional
]);
```

### reject()

```php
use Scell\Sdk\Enums\RejectionCode;

$invoice = $client->invoices()->reject(
    id:         'invoice-uuid',
    reason:     'Montant incorrect',
    reasonCode: RejectionCode::IncorrectAmount,  // or string
);
```

### dispute()

```php
use Scell\Sdk\Enums\DisputeType;

$invoice = $client->invoices()->dispute(
    id:             'invoice-uuid',
    reason:         'Qualite non conforme',
    disputeType:    DisputeType::QualityDispute,
    expectedAmount: 950.00,  // optional
);
```

### markPaid()

```php
$invoice = $client->invoices()->markPaid('invoice-uuid', [
    'payment_reference' => 'VIR-2026-001',  // optional
    'paid_at'           => '2026-02-15',     // optional
    'note'              => 'Paiement recu',  // optional
]);
```

### submit()

```php
$result = $client->invoices()->submit('invoice-uuid');
// Returns array{data: array, message?: string}
```

### download()

```php
$result = $client->invoices()->download('invoice-uuid', 'converted');
// type: 'original', 'converted', 'pdf'
// Returns array{url: string, expires_at: string}
```

### downloadContent()

```php
// Download binary content
$pdf = $client->invoices()->downloadContent('invoice-uuid', 'pdf');  // Factur-X
$xml = $client->invoices()->downloadContent('invoice-uuid', 'xml');  // UBL or CII
file_put_contents('invoice.pdf', $pdf);
```

### auditTrail()

```php
$trail = $client->invoices()->auditTrail('invoice-uuid');
// Returns array{data: array[], integrity_valid: bool}
```

### convert()

```php
$result = $client->invoices()->convert('invoice-uuid', OutputFormat::UBL);
// Returns array{message: string, invoice_id: string, target_format: string}
```

## Invoice DTO

`Scell\Sdk\DTOs\Invoice` — readonly class

Properties:
- `id: string` — UUID
- `invoiceNumber: string` — Server-generated (DRAFT-XXXXX or fiscal number)
- `externalId: ?string`
- `direction: string` — 'outgoing' | 'incoming'
- `status: string` — InvoiceStatus value
- `outputFormat: string` — 'facturx' | 'ubl' | 'cii'
- `issueDate: ?string`
- `dueDate: ?string`
- `currency: string` — default 'EUR'
- `totalHt: float`
- `totalTax: float`
- `totalTtc: float`
- `sellerSiret: ?string` — nullable (international invoices)
- `sellerName: string`
- `sellerVatNumber: ?string`
- `sellerCountry: ?string`
- `sellerLegalId: ?string`
- `sellerLegalIdScheme: ?string`
- `buyerSiret: ?string` — nullable (international invoices, B2C)
- `buyerName: string`
- `buyerVatNumber: ?string`
- `buyerCountry: ?string`
- `buyerLegalId: ?string`
- `buyerLegalIdScheme: ?string`
- `buyerIsIndividual: bool` — **B2C flag** (default false). When true, buyer SIRET/SIREN/VAT/legal_id are optional. Factur-X / UBL / CII generation omits BT-46/BT-47/BT-48 (BR-CO-26 EN16931 compliant).
- `lines: InvoiceLine[]`
- `environment: string` — 'production' | 'sandbox'
- `paidAt: ?string`
- `paymentReference: ?string`
- `paymentNote: ?string`
- `createdAt: string`
- `updatedAt: string`

Helper methods:
```php
$invoice->isSandbox(): bool
$invoice->isOutgoing(): bool
$invoice->isFinal(): bool    // status is 'validated' or 'transmitted'
$invoice->isPaid(): bool
$invoice->isIncoming(): bool
$invoice->isB2c(): bool      // returns buyerIsIndividual
$invoice->isB2b(): bool      // !buyerIsIndividual
```

---

## InvoiceLine DTO

`Scell\Sdk\DTOs\InvoiceLine` — readonly class

Properties:
- `description: string`
- `quantity: float`
- `unitPrice: float`
- `taxRate: float`
- `totalHt: float`
- `totalTax: float`
- `totalTtc: float`
- `unit: ?string`

Named constructor:
```php
$line = InvoiceLine::create(
    description: 'Consulting',
    quantity:    2.0,
    unitPrice:   500.00,
    taxRate:     20.0,
    unit:        null,   // optional
);
// auto-calculates totalHt=1000.00, totalTax=200.00, totalTtc=1200.00

// Or from array
$line = InvoiceLine::fromArray([
    'description' => 'Consulting',
    'quantity'    => 2.0,
    'unit_price'  => 500.00,
    'tax_rate'    => 20.0,
    'total_ht'    => 1000.00,
    'total_tax'   => 200.00,
    'total_ttc'   => 1200.00,
]);

$line->toArray(): array
```

## SignatureResource

Accessed via `$client->signatures()`.

### list()

```php
use Scell\Sdk\Enums\SignatureStatus;

$result = $client->signatures()->list([
    'status'   => SignatureStatus::Pending,  // optional
    'from'     => '2026-01-01',
    'to'       => '2026-12-31',
    'per_page' => 25,
    'page'     => 1,
]);
// Returns PaginatedResult<Signature>
```

### get()

```php
$signature = $client->signatures()->get('uuid');
// Returns Signature DTO
```

### create() — Raw array

```php
$signature = $client->signatures()->create([
    'title'     => 'Contrat de prestation',
    'document'  => base64_encode(file_get_contents('contract.pdf')),
    'signers'   => [
        [
            'name'         => 'Jean Dupont',
            'email'        => 'jean@example.com',
            'phone'        => '+33612345678',
            'auth_method'  => 'otp_email',  // 'otp_email' or 'otp_sms'
        ],
    ],
    'message'     => 'Merci de signer ce contrat.',  // optional
    'external_id' => 'CONTRACT-001',                 // optional
    'expires_at'  => '2026-02-26',                   // optional
]);
// Returns Signature DTO
```

### create() — Fluent builder

```php
use Scell\Sdk\Enums\AuthMethod;

$signature = $client->signatures()->builder()
    ->title('Contrat de prestation')
    ->documentFromPath('/path/to/contract.pdf')
    ->message('Merci de signer.')
    ->externalId('CONTRACT-001')
    ->expiresAt('2026-02-26')
    ->addSigner(
        name:       'Jean Dupont',
        email:      'jean@example.com',
        phone:      '+33612345678',
        authMethod: AuthMethod::OtpEmail,
    )
    ->addSigner(
        name:       'Marie Martin',
        email:      'marie@example.com',
        phone:      '+33698765432',
        authMethod: AuthMethod::OtpSms,
    )
    ->create();
```

### builder() — SignatureBuilder methods

```php
$builder = $client->signatures()->builder();

$builder->title(string $title)
$builder->document(string $base64Content)
$builder->documentFromPath(string $path)         // reads and base64-encodes file
$builder->message(string $message)
$builder->externalId(string $id)
$builder->expiresAt(DateTimeInterface|string $date)
$builder->addSigner(string $firstName, string $lastName, AuthMethod $authMethod, ?string $email = null, ?string $phone = null, ?string $message = null)
$builder->addEmailSigner(string $firstName, string $lastName, string $email, ?string $message = null)
$builder->addSmsSigner(string $firstName, string $lastName, string $phone, ?string $message = null)
$builder->addSignerDto(Signer $signer)
$builder->addSignaturePosition(int $page, float $x, float $y, ?float $width = null, ?float $height = null, string $unit = 'percent')
$builder->uiConfig(array $config)                // v1.12.0 — sidebar_*, header_*, footer_*, button_*, sign_button_*, hide_*, iframe_ancestors (BREAKING: anciennement 3 params positionnels)
$builder->signatureOptions(array $options)       // v1.12.0 — signature_mode, signer_must_read, user_editable_data, timezone
$builder->create(): Signature
```

### Signer message & position unit (v1.12.0)

```php
// Message custom par signataire (max 500 chars, placeholder {OTP})
$builder->addEmailSigner('Jean', 'Dupont', 'jean@example.com', message: 'Code OTP : {OTP}');

// Coordonnees en pourcentage (defaut) ou en pixels
$builder->addSignaturePosition(1, 70.0, 85.0, 20.0, 5.0, 'percent');
$builder->addSignaturePosition(1, 450.0, 680.0, 150.0, 40.0, 'pixel');

// UI (21 champs alignes sur la spec OpenAPI.com)
$builder->uiConfig([
    'sidebar_logo'             => 'https://cdn.example.com/logo.svg',
    'sidebar_background_color' => '#0F172A',
    'sidebar_text_color'       => '#FFFFFF',
    'header_logo'              => '...',
    'header_background_color'  => '#FFFFFF',
    'header_text_color'        => '#000000',
    'footer_text'              => 'Powered by Example',
    'footer_background_color'  => '#F5F5F5',
    'footer_text_color'        => '#333333',
    'button_background_color'  => '#0066CC',
    'button_text_color'        => '#FFFFFF',
    'sign_button_background_color' => '#00AA66',
    'sign_button_text_color'   => '#FFFFFF',
    'hide_header'              => false,
    'hide_footer'              => false,
    'hide_sidebar'             => false,
    'hide_branding'            => true,
    'iframe_ancestors'         => ['https://app.example.com'],
]);

// Options de signature
$builder->signatureOptions([
    'signature_mode'     => 'both',           // 'draw' | 'type' | 'both'
    'signer_must_read'   => true,
    'user_editable_data' => false,
    'timezone'           => 'Europe/Paris',
]);
```

## CreditNoteResource

Accessed via `$client->creditNotes()`.

### list()

```php
$result = $client->creditNotes()->list([
    'status'   => 'draft',
    'from'     => '2026-01-01',
    'per_page' => 25,
]);
// Returns PaginatedResult<CreditNote>
```

### get()

```php
$creditNote = $client->creditNotes()->get('uuid');
```

### create()

```php
$creditNote = $client->creditNotes()->create([
    'invoice_id' => 'invoice-uuid',
    'reason'     => 'Remboursement partiel',
    'type'       => 'partial',  // 'full' or 'partial'
    'items'      => [
        [
            'description' => 'Consulting - annule',
            'quantity'    => 1.0,
            'unit_price'  => 500.00,
            'tax_rate'    => 20.0,
        ],
    ],
]);
```

### Other methods

```php
$client->creditNotes()->send('uuid'): CreditNote
$client->creditNotes()->download('uuid'): array       // array{url: string, expires_at: string}
$client->creditNotes()->remainingCreditable('uuid'): array
```

## WebhookVerifier

`Scell\Sdk\Webhooks\WebhookVerifier`

Verifies HMAC-SHA256 webhook signatures with 300-second timestamp tolerance.

```php
use Scell\Sdk\Webhooks\WebhookVerifier;

$verifier = new WebhookVerifier('your-webhook-secret');

// In a Laravel controller:
public function handle(Request $request): Response
{
    $payload = $verifier->verify(
        payload:   $request->getContent(),
        signature: $request->header('X-Scell-Signature'),
        timestamp: $request->header('X-Scell-Timestamp'),
    );
    // Returns WebhookPayload on success, throws ScellException on failure

    switch ($payload->event) {
        case 'invoice.created':
            // $payload->data contains the invoice array
            break;
        case 'invoice.status_changed':
            break;
    }

    return response()->json(['ok' => true]);
}

// Check without throwing
$isValid = $verifier->isValid($rawBody, $signature, $timestamp): bool;

// Skip timestamp check (dev only)
$payload = $verifier->verifyIgnoringTimestamp($rawBody, $signature);

// Generate a signature (for testing)
$sig = $verifier->generateSignature($rawBody, $timestamp): string;
```

### WebhookPayload DTO (embedded in WebhookVerifier.php)

Properties:
- `event: string`
- `data: array`
- `timestamp: int`
- `environment: string`

## TenantInvoiceResource

Accessed via `$api->tenantInvoices()` or `$tenant->invoices()`.

```php
// Create invoice for a sub-tenant
$invoice = $api->tenantInvoices()->createForSubTenant('sub-tenant-uuid', [
    'direction'     => 'outgoing',
    'output_format' => 'facturx',
    'issue_date'    => '2026-01-26',
    // ... seller, buyer, lines, totals
]);

// List invoices for a sub-tenant
$result = $api->tenantInvoices()->listForSubTenant('sub-tenant-uuid', [
    'status'   => 'validated',
    'per_page' => 25,
]);

// Get a single invoice
$invoice = $api->tenantInvoices()->get('invoice-uuid');

// Update a draft invoice
$invoice = $api->tenantInvoices()->update('invoice-uuid', [
    'due_date' => '2026-02-26',
]);

// Delete a draft
$api->tenantInvoices()->delete('invoice-uuid');

// Submit for processing
$api->tenantInvoices()->submit('invoice-uuid');

// Get status
$status = $api->tenantInvoices()->status('invoice-uuid'): array;

// Remaining creditable amounts
$amounts = $api->tenantInvoices()->remainingCreditable('invoice-uuid'): array;

// Download — Factur-X PDF/A-3 (default) — renvoie binary string
$pdf = $api->tenantInvoices()->download('invoice-uuid');
file_put_contents('invoice.pdf', $pdf);

// XML pur (UBL ou CII selon output_format)
$xml = $api->tenantInvoices()->download('invoice-uuid', 'xml');

// Scope sub-tenant (404 si la facture appartient a un autre sub-tenant)
$pdf = $api->tenantInvoices()->downloadForSubTenant('sub-tenant-uuid', 'invoice-uuid');
```

## FiscalResource (ISCA Compliance)

Accessed via `$api->fiscal()` or `$tenant->fiscal()`.

Implements LF 2026 fiscal compliance (ISCA, Article 286-I-3° bis CGI).

### Compliance Dashboard

```php
$compliance = $api->fiscal()->compliance(): FiscalCompliance;
```

### Integrity

```php
$report  = $api->fiscal()->integrity(): FiscalIntegrityReport;
$history = $api->fiscal()->integrityHistory(['per_page' => 50]): PaginatedResult;
$report  = $api->fiscal()->integrityForDate('2026-01-15'): FiscalIntegrityReport;
```

### Closings

```php
$result  = $api->fiscal()->closings(['per_page' => 30]): PaginatedResult;
$summary = $api->fiscal()->performDailyClosing(): FiscalClosingSummary;
```

### FEC Export

```php
$fec = $api->fiscal()->fecExport([
    'from' => '2026-01-01',
    'to'   => '2026-12-31',
]): array;
// Returns FEC text file content or structured array
```

### Attestation

```php
$attestation = $api->fiscal()->attestation(): FiscalAttestation;
$pdf         = $api->fiscal()->attestationDownload(): string;  // binary PDF
```

### ISCA Self-Attestation NOMINATIVE (since v1.16.0)

PDF inclut l'identite du beneficiaire (legal_name, SIRET, TVA, adresse, contact,
statut KYB/KYC) + nom + version du logiciel + identite de l'editeur. Le hash
SHA-256 couvre le bloc beneficiaire — preuve cryptographique de la
non-transferabilite (deux beneficiaires distincts = deux hashes distincts).

```php
// Auto-attestation pour le tenant authentifie (donnees KYB)
$tenantPdf = $api->fiscal()->iscaSelfAttestationDownload(): string; // binary PDF
file_put_contents('attestation-tenant.pdf', $tenantPdf);

// Auto-attestation pour un sub_tenant specifique
// 404 si introuvable ou n'appartient pas au tenant authentifie (verif IDOR)
$subPdf = $api->fiscal()->iscaSelfAttestationDownload('019d5ea8-...'): string;
file_put_contents('attestation-sub-tenant.pdf', $subPdf);

// Documents de conformite (non-nominatifs)
$measures = $api->fiscal()->iscaMeasuresRegisterDownload(): string; // binary PDF
$dossier  = $api->fiscal()->iscaTechnicalDossierDownload(): string; // binary PDF
```

### Ledger Entries

```php
$result = $api->fiscal()->entries([
    'from'     => '2026-01-01',
    'to'       => '2026-12-31',
    'per_page' => 100,
]): PaginatedResult;
```

### Kill Switch

```php
$status = $api->fiscal()->killSwitchStatus(): FiscalKillSwitchStatus;
$result = $api->fiscal()->killSwitchActivate(['reason' => 'Audit en cours']): array;
$result = $api->fiscal()->killSwitchDeactivate(): array;
```

### Anchors

```php
$result = $api->fiscal()->anchors(['per_page' => 50]): PaginatedResult;
// FiscalAnchor DTOs (RFC 3161 TSA)
```

### Rules

```php
$result = $api->fiscal()->rules(): array;
$rule   = $api->fiscal()->ruleDetail(string $ruleId): FiscalRule;
$hist   = $api->fiscal()->ruleHistory(string $ruleId): array;
$rule   = $api->fiscal()->createRule(array $data): FiscalRule;
$rule   = $api->fiscal()->updateRule(string $ruleId, array $data): FiscalRule;
$result = $api->fiscal()->exportRules(): array;
$result = $api->fiscal()->replayRules(array $data): array;
```

### Forensic Export

```php
$result = $api->fiscal()->forensicExport([
    'from' => '2026-01-01',
    'to'   => '2026-12-31',
]): array;
```

### ISCA Document Downloads

```php
$pdf = $api->fiscal()->downloadMeasuresRegister(): string;      // binary PDF
$pdf = $api->fiscal()->downloadTechnicalDossier(): string;      // binary PDF
$pdf = $api->fiscal()->downloadSelfAttestation(): string;       // binary PDF
```

## OnboardingResource

Accessed via `$api->onboarding()` or `$tenant->onboarding()`.

SuperPDP OAuth2 Authorization Code flow for partner onboarding.

```php
// Step 1: Create onboarding session
$session = $api->onboarding()->createSession([
    'partner_name'     => 'Mon Partenaire',
    'redirect_uri'     => 'https://myapp.com/onboarding/callback',
    'external_id'      => 'PARTNER-001',
]);
// Returns OnboardingSession DTO

// Step 2: Get the authorize URL
$auth = $api->onboarding()->getSuperPDPAuthorizeUrl($session->id);
// Returns array{authorize_url: string, state: string}
// Redirect user to $auth['authorize_url']

// Step 3: Handle OAuth2 callback
$result = $api->onboarding()->superpdpCallback(
    sessionId: $session->id,
    code:      $request->query('code'),
    state:     $request->query('state'),
);
// Returns array{success: bool, tenant_id: string, ...}

// Check session status
$session = $api->onboarding()->getSession($session->id);
```

---

## OnboardingSession DTO

`Scell\Sdk\DTOs\OnboardingSession` — readonly class

Properties:
- `id: string`
- `status: string` — 'pending' | 'in_progress' | 'completed' | 'failed'
- `partnerName: string`
- `externalId: ?string`
- `redirectUri: string`
- `authorizeUrl: ?string`
- `state: ?string`
- `tenantId: ?string`
- `createdAt: string`
- `updatedAt: string`
- `expiresAt: ?string`

---

## Exception Hierarchy

```
\Exception
└── ScellException                       base, has fromResponse() factory
    ├── AuthenticationException          HTTP 401 — invalid or missing credentials
    ├── InsufficientBalanceException     HTTP 402 — not enough credits
    ├── ValidationException              HTTP 422 — invalid input data
    │   └── $errors: array              field-level validation errors
    └── RateLimitException               HTTP 429 — too many requests
        └── $retryAfter: ?int           seconds until retry allowed
```

```php
use Scell\Sdk\Exceptions\ScellException;
use Scell\Sdk\Exceptions\AuthenticationException;
use Scell\Sdk\Exceptions\InsufficientBalanceException;
use Scell\Sdk\Exceptions\ValidationException;
use Scell\Sdk\Exceptions\RateLimitException;

try {
    $invoice = $client->invoices()->create([...]);
} catch (AuthenticationException $e) {
    // 401 — check your API key/token
    echo $e->getMessage();
} catch (InsufficientBalanceException $e) {
    // 402 — top up credits
} catch (ValidationException $e) {
    // 422 — validation errors
    foreach ($e->getErrors() as $field => $messages) {
        echo "{$field}: " . implode(', ', $messages);
    }
} catch (RateLimitException $e) {
    // 429 — rate limited
    $retryAfter = $e->getRetryAfter(); // ?int seconds
    sleep($retryAfter ?? 60);
} catch (ScellException $e) {
    // Other API errors (5xx, network issues, etc.)
    echo "Status: " . $e->getCode();
    echo "Message: " . $e->getMessage();
}
```

`ScellException::fromResponse(ResponseInterface $response)` factory maps HTTP status codes to typed exceptions.

---

## Laravel Integration

### Installation

```bash
composer require scell/sdk
php artisan vendor:publish --tag=scell-config
```

Auto-discovery via `extra.laravel` in composer.json. Registers:
- `ScellServiceProvider`
- Aliases: `Scell` (Bearer), `ScellApi` (API Key), `ScellWebhook`

### Configuration (config/scell.php)

Published config with environment variables:

```env
SCELL_BASE_URL=https://api.scell.io/api/v1
SCELL_BEARER_TOKEN=eyJ...
SCELL_API_KEY=tk_live_abc123...
SCELL_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_...
SCELL_HTTP_TIMEOUT=30
SCELL_HTTP_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=10
SCELL_HTTP_RETRY_ATTEMPTS=3
SCELL_HTTP_RETRY_DELAY=100
SCELL_HTTP_VERIFY_SSL=true
SCELL_ENVIRONMENT=production
SCELL_LOGGING_ENABLED=true
SCELL_LOGGING_CHANNEL=stack
```

### Using Facades

```php
use Scell\Sdk\Laravel\Facades\Scell;
use Scell\Sdk\Laravel\Facades\ScellApi;
use Scell\Sdk\Laravel\Facades\ScellWebhook;

// ScellClient facade (Bearer token)
$invoice = Scell::invoices()->get('uuid');
$result  = Scell::signatures()->list();

// ScellApiClient facade (API Key)
$invoice = ScellApi::invoices()->create([...]);
$subs    = ScellApi::subTenants()->list();

// WebhookVerifier facade
$payload = ScellWebhook::verify($rawBody, $signature, $timestamp);
```

### Dependency Injection

```php
use Scell\Sdk\ScellClient;
use Scell\Sdk\ScellApiClient;
use Scell\Sdk\Webhooks\WebhookVerifier;

class InvoiceController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ScellApiClient $scell,
    ) {}

    public function store(CreateInvoiceRequest $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $invoice = $this->scell->invoices()->create($request->validated());
        return response()->json(['invoice' => $invoice]);
    }
}

class WebhookController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly WebhookVerifier $verifier,
    ) {}

    public function handle(Request $request): Response
    {
        $payload = $this->verifier->verify(
            $request->getContent(),
            $request->header('X-Scell-Signature'),
            $request->header('X-Scell-Timestamp'),
        );
        // handle $payload->event
        return response()->json(['ok' => true]);
    }
}
```

---

## HTTP Client Details

### Retry Middleware

Automatic retry with exponential backoff on:
- Network errors (connection refused, DNS failures)
- HTTP 429 (rate limit) — respects `Retry-After` header
- HTTP 5xx server errors

Default: 3 attempts, 100ms base delay. Delay formula: `min(delay * 2^attempt, 30000)`.

### Headers

Every request includes:
- `User-Agent: Scell-PHP-SDK/1.11.0`
- `Accept: application/json`
- `Content-Type: application/json`
- Auth header depending on client type

### getRaw()

For binary downloads (PDF, XML), `HttpClient::getRaw()` sends `Accept: */*` and returns raw string content instead of parsing JSON.

---

## Common Patterns

### Pattern 1: Create and submit an invoice in one go

```php
$api = ScellApiClient::withApiKey('tk_live_abc123...');

$invoice = $api->invoices()->builder()
    ->outgoing()
    ->facturX()
    ->issueDate(new DateTime())
    ->seller('12345678901234', 'Ma Societe', ['street' => '1 rue de la Paix', 'city' => 'Paris', 'postal_code' => '75001', 'country' => 'FR'])
    ->buyer('98765432109876', 'Client SA', ['street' => '10 av. de la Gare', 'city' => 'Lyon', 'postal_code' => '69001', 'country' => 'FR'])
    ->addLine('Consulting', 2.0, 500.00, 20.0)
    ->addLine('Formation', 1.0, 1500.00, 20.0)
    ->create();

// Submit for processing (DRAFT → submitted)
$api->invoices()->submit($invoice->id);
```

### Pattern 2: List and paginate invoices

```php
$page = 1;
do {
    $result = $api->invoices()->list([
        'direction' => 'outgoing',
        'status'    => 'validated',
        'per_page'  => 50,
        'page'      => $page,
    ]);
    foreach ($result->data as $invoice) {
        // process invoice
    }
    $page++;
} while ($result->hasNextPage());
```

### Pattern 3: Download invoice as PDF

```php
$pdf = $api->invoices()->downloadContent($invoice->id, 'pdf');
Storage::put("invoices/{$invoice->invoiceNumber}.pdf", $pdf);

// Or get a temporary URL
$download = $api->invoices()->download($invoice->id, 'converted');
return redirect($download['url']);
```

### Pattern 4: Handle incoming invoices (full lifecycle)

```php
$incoming = $api->invoices()->incoming(['status' => 'received']);

foreach ($incoming->data as $invoice) {
    if ($this->isValidInvoice($invoice)) {
        $api->invoices()->accept($invoice->id, ['comment' => 'Conforme']);
    } else {
        $api->invoices()->reject(
            $invoice->id,
            'Montant ne correspond pas au bon de commande',
            RejectionCode::IncorrectAmount,
        );
    }
}

// Later, mark as paid
$api->invoices()->markPaid($invoice->id, [
    'payment_reference' => 'VIR-2026-042',
    'paid_at'           => '2026-02-15',
]);
```

### Pattern 5: Electronic signature flow

```php
$signature = $api->signatures()->builder()
    ->title('NDA - Projet Alpha')
    ->documentFromPath(storage_path('contracts/nda.pdf'))
    ->message('Merci de signer le NDA avant notre réunion.')
    ->addSigner('Jean Dupont', 'jean@partner.com', '+33612345678', AuthMethod::OtpEmail)
    ->addSigner('Marie Martin', 'marie@partner.com', '+33698765432', AuthMethod::OtpSms)
    ->expiresAt(new DateTime('+7 days'))
    ->create();

echo "Signature créée: " . $signature->id;

// Later, check status
$signature = $api->signatures()->get($signature->id);
if ($signature->status === 'completed') {
    $url = $api->signatures()->download($signature->id);
    // Download the signed document
}
```

### Pattern 6: Handle webhooks in Laravel

```php
// routes/api.php
Route::post('/webhooks/scell', [ScellWebhookController::class, 'handle'])
    ->withoutMiddleware([VerifyCsrfToken::class]);

// app/Http/Controllers/ScellWebhookController.php
use Scell\Sdk\Webhooks\WebhookVerifier;

class ScellWebhookController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly WebhookVerifier $verifier
    ) {}

    public function handle(Request $request): Response
    {
        try {
            $payload = $this->verifier->verify(
                $request->getContent(),
                $request->header('X-Scell-Signature'),
                $request->header('X-Scell-Timestamp'),
            );
        } catch (\Scell\Sdk\Exceptions\ScellException $e) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Invalid signature'], 401);
        }

        match ($payload->event) {
            'invoice.validated'        => $this->onInvoiceValidated($payload->data),
            'invoice.incoming.received' => $this->onIncomingReceived($payload->data),
            'signature.completed'       => $this->onSignatureCompleted($payload->data),
            default                    => null,
        };

        return response()->json(['received' => true]);
    }
}
```

### Pattern 7: Multi-tenant — create invoice for sub-tenant

```php
$tenant = ScellTenantClient::create('tk_live_abc123...');

// Get or create sub-tenant
$subTenant = $tenant->subTenants()->findByExternalId('CLIENT-001')
    ?? $tenant->subTenants()->create([
        'external_id' => 'CLIENT-001',
        'name'        => 'Mon Client SARL',
        'siret'       => '12345678901234',
        'email'       => 'contact@client.fr',
    ]);

// Create invoice
$invoice = $tenant->invoices()->createForSubTenant($subTenant->id, [
    'direction'     => 'outgoing',
    'output_format' => 'facturx',
    'issue_date'    => '2026-01-26',
    'seller'        => [
        'siret'    => $subTenant->siret,
        'name'     => $subTenant->name,
        'address'  => ['street' => '...', 'city' => '...', 'postal_code' => '...', 'country' => 'FR'],
    ],
    'buyer'  => ['siret' => '98765432109876', 'name' => 'Acheteur SA', 'address' => [...]],
    'lines'  => [['description' => 'Service', 'quantity' => 1.0, 'unit_price' => 1000.00, 'tax_rate' => 20.0]],
    'total_ht'  => 1000.00,
    'total_tax' => 200.00,
    'total_ttc' => 1200.00,
]);

$tenant->invoices()->submit($invoice->id);
```

### Pattern 8: Partner onboarding via SuperPDP OAuth2

```php
$api = ScellApiClient::withApiKey('tk_live_abc123...');

// Initiate onboarding
$session = $api->onboarding()->createSession([
    'partner_name' => 'Nouveau Partenaire',
    'redirect_uri' => route('onboarding.callback'),
    'external_id'  => 'PARTNER-' . $partner->id,
]);

// Store session ID for callback
session(['onboarding_session_id' => $session->id]);

// Get the authorize URL and redirect user
$auth = $api->onboarding()->getSuperPDPAuthorizeUrl($session->id);
return redirect($auth['authorize_url']);

// --- In callback controller ---
public function callback(Request $request): Response
{
    $sessionId = session('onboarding_session_id');

    $result = $api->onboarding()->superpdpCallback(
        sessionId: $sessionId,
        code:      $request->query('code'),
        state:     $request->query('state'),
    );

    if ($result['success'] ?? false) {
        // Tenant provisioned, store $result['tenant_id']
    }

    return redirect()->route('dashboard');
}
```

### Pattern 9: International invoicing (non-SIRET)

```php
// EU company without SIRET (e.g., German company with VAT)
$invoice = $api->invoices()->create([
    'direction'        => 'outgoing',
    'output_format'    => 'ubl',
    'issue_date'       => '2026-01-26',
    'total_ht'         => 1000.00,
    'total_tax'        => 0.00,     // reverse charge
    'total_ttc'        => 1000.00,
    'seller_siret'     => '12345678901234',
    'seller_name'      => 'Ma Societe SAS',
    'seller_address'   => ['street' => '1 rue de la Paix', 'city' => 'Paris', 'postal_code' => '75001', 'country' => 'FR'],
    'buyer_siret'      => null,
    'buyer_name'       => 'Deutscher Kunde GmbH',
    'buyer_vat_number' => 'DE123456789',
    'buyer_country'    => 'DE',
    'buyer_legal_id'   => 'HRB-12345',
    'buyer_legal_id_scheme' => 'DE:HRB',
    'buyer_address'    => ['street' => 'Hauptstraße 1', 'city' => 'Berlin', 'postal_code' => '10115', 'country' => 'DE'],
    'lines'            => [...],
]);
```

### Pattern 10: ISCA fiscal compliance check

```php
$api = ScellApiClient::withApiKey('tk_live_abc123...');
$fiscal = $api->fiscal();

// Daily compliance check
$compliance = $fiscal->compliance();
if (!$compliance->isCompliant) {
    // Alert: system not compliant
}

// Integrity verification
$report = $fiscal->integrity();
if (!$report->isValid) {
    foreach ($report->errors as $error) {
        Log::critical('Fiscal integrity error', $error);
    }
}

// Perform daily closing (schedule via cron)
$closing = $fiscal->performDailyClosing();

// FEC export for tax authorities
$fec = $fiscal->fecExport(['from' => '2026-01-01', 'to' => '2026-12-31']);

// Download ISCA compliance documents
$measuresRegister   = $fiscal->downloadMeasuresRegister();
$technicalDossier   = $fiscal->downloadTechnicalDossier();
$selfAttestation    = $fiscal->downloadSelfAttestation();
```

### Pattern 11: Error handling with retry

```php
use Scell\Sdk\Exceptions\RateLimitException;
use Scell\Sdk\Exceptions\ValidationException;

function createInvoiceWithRetry(ScellApiClient $api, array $data, int $maxRetries = 3): Invoice
{
    $attempt = 0;
    while ($attempt < $maxRetries) {
        try {
            return $api->invoices()->create($data);
        } catch (RateLimitException $e) {
            $wait = $e->getRetryAfter() ?? 60;
            sleep($wait);
            $attempt++;
        } catch (ValidationException $e) {
            // Don't retry validation errors — fix the data
            throw $e;
        }
    }
    throw new \RuntimeException('Max retries exceeded');
}
```

### Pattern 12: Bulk operations via TenantDirectInvoiceResource

```php
$tenant = ScellTenantClient::create('tk_live_abc123...');

// Create multiple invoices
$invoices = $tenant->directInvoices()->bulkCreate([
    ['direction' => 'outgoing', ...],
    ['direction' => 'outgoing', ...],
]);

// Submit all at once
$ids = array_column($invoices, 'id');
$results = $tenant->directInvoices()->bulkSubmit(['invoice_ids' => $ids]);

// Check bulk status
$statuses = $tenant->directInvoices()->bulkStatus(['invoice_ids' => $ids]);
```

### Pattern 13: Audit trail verification

```php
// Verify invoice audit trail
$trail = $api->invoices()->auditTrail($invoice->id);
if (!$trail['integrity_valid']) {
    Log::critical('Invoice audit trail integrity failure', ['invoice_id' => $invoice->id]);
}

foreach ($trail['data'] as $entry) {
    echo "{$entry['event']} at {$entry['created_at']}\n";
}

// Same for signatures
$trail = $api->signatures()->auditTrail($signature->id);
```

### Pattern 14: Credit note creation

```php
// Full credit note (cancel entire invoice)
$creditNote = $api->creditNotes()->create([
    'invoice_id' => $invoice->id,
    'reason'     => 'Annulation commande client',
    'type'       => 'full',
    'items'      => [],  // full credit takes all invoice lines
]);

// Partial credit note
$creditNote = $api->creditNotes()->create([
    'invoice_id' => $invoice->id,
    'reason'     => 'Remboursement partiel',
    'type'       => 'partial',
    'items'      => [
        [
            'description' => 'Consulting - ligne annulée',
            'quantity'    => 1.0,
            'unit_price'  => 500.00,
            'tax_rate'    => 20.0,
        ],
    ],
]);

$api->creditNotes()->send($creditNote->id);

// Check remaining creditable amount
$remaining = $api->creditNotes()->remainingCreditable($invoice->id);
```

### Pattern 15: Sandbox vs production

```php
// Sandbox — key prefix is tk_test_, routing is server-side
$sandboxApi = ScellApiClient::sandbox('tk_test_abc123...');

// Create a test invoice in sandbox
$invoice = $sandboxApi->invoices()->create([...]);
echo $invoice->environment; // 'sandbox'

// Production — key prefix is tk_live_
$prodApi = ScellApiClient::withApiKey('tk_live_abc123...');

// Both use the same API URL: https://api.scell.io/api/v1
// The server routes based on the key prefix
```

### Pattern 16: ScellTenantClient — self-management

```php
$tenant = ScellTenantClient::create('tk_live_abc123...');

// Get tenant info
$me = $tenant->me();
echo $me['data']['name'];

// Get balance
$balance = $tenant->balance();
echo "Credits: " . $balance['data']['credits'];

// Get stats
$stats = $tenant->stats();
echo "Invoices this month: " . $stats['data']['invoices_this_month'];

// Regenerate tenant key (old key is immediately invalidated)
$result = $tenant->regenerateKey();
$newKey = $result['data']['tenant_key'];
// IMPORTANT: update your stored key immediately
```

---

## Migration Notes

### v1.5.0 — Key prefix changed

API keys changed from `sk_live_*`/`sk_test_*` to `tk_live_*`/`tk_test_*`. Update all stored keys.

### v1.8.0 — International invoicing

`sellerSiret` and `buyerSiret` on `Invoice` DTO are now nullable. Added: `vatNumber`, `country`, `legalId`, `legalIdScheme` for both seller and buyer. `Company::siret` now nullable.

### v1.9.0 — Server-generated invoice numbers

`invoice_number` is no longer accepted as input when creating invoices. Numbers are assigned automatically:
- At creation: `DRAFT-XXXXX`
- At submit: fiscal number

`InvoiceBuilder::invoiceNumber()` is now a no-op (deprecated, kept for BC). Remove any code that sets invoice numbers manually.

### v1.9.2 — ISCA terminology

Legacy fiscal certification terminology replaced with ISCA throughout the codebase. Affects: PHPDoc comments, method names in FiscalResource (e.g., `downloadMeasuresRegister()`, `downloadTechnicalDossier()`, `downloadSelfAttestation()`).

### v1.10.0 — OnboardingResource

`$api->onboarding()` accessor added to `ScellApiClient`. New `OnboardingSession` DTO. SuperPDP OAuth2 Authorization Code flow for partner onboarding.

### v1.11.0 — Critical fix + ScellTenantClient::onboarding()

- Fixed `undefined index` bug in `normalizeCreatePayload()` when using fluent builder (dead `invoice_number` field)
- `ScellTenantClient::onboarding()` added (was missing from v1.10.0)
- PHPDoc examples updated: all `sk_live_*`/`sk_test_*` → `tk_live_*`/`tk_test_*`

---

## Environment Variables Reference

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `SCELL_BASE_URL` | `https://api.scell.io/api/v1` | API base URL |
| `SCELL_BEARER_TOKEN` | — | Bearer token for ScellClient |
| `SCELL_API_KEY` | — | API key for ScellApiClient |
| `SCELL_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | — | Webhook HMAC secret |
| `SCELL_HTTP_TIMEOUT` | `30` | Request timeout (seconds) |
| `SCELL_HTTP_CONNECT_TIMEOUT` | `10` | Connection timeout (seconds) |
| `SCELL_HTTP_RETRY_ATTEMPTS` | `3` | Max retry attempts |
| `SCELL_HTTP_RETRY_DELAY` | `100` | Base retry delay (ms) |
| `SCELL_HTTP_VERIFY_SSL` | `true` | SSL verification |
| `SCELL_ENVIRONMENT` | `production` | Default environment |

---

## Rate Limits

The API enforces rate limits. On HTTP 429, the SDK:
1. Automatically retries up to `retry_attempts` times (default 3) with exponential backoff
2. Respects the `Retry-After` response header
3. Throws `RateLimitException` after all retries are exhausted

`RateLimitException::getRetryAfter(): ?int` returns seconds to wait.
